events.info: A valid physical ID is required to attend any age restricted events and to consume alcohol. Accepted forms of identification include state-issued ID or Driver's License, valid non-expired US Government or US Military ID, or an official passport. The Depot has a very strict underage drinking policy that follows state law, and if you do not have acceptable ID that states your age at 21 or older, you will be considered the same as a minor and will not be able to purchase, consume or possess alcohol in the venue. Violators will be removed from the building without warnings and will not be eligible for a refund.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is open one hour before doors on show days only.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The venue accepts the following methods of payment: VISA, Mastercard, AMX, Discover. Cash is accepted at the box office only.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets can only be picked up at the venue Box Office on the night of the event. Acceptable forms of identification include: a valid passport, a valid U.S. driver's license or military identification card with a date of birth and a photo, or an official U.S. state issued identification card. Please note that will call tickets will not be distributed prior to the day of the event.

venues.parkingDetail: The Depot has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer easy and reliable parking options. Click below to book parking. https://www.parkwhiz.com/the-depot-parking?pwa=pa-1269&utm_medium=LiveNation&utm_source=1269&utm_campaign=Web_LN_ParkingPage_VenueLink
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The Depot strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to everyone. For detailed ADA information, please visit https://www.depotslc.com/accessibility.

generalInfo.generalRule: All attendees (ages 3 and over) are required to purchase a full price ticket. The Depot has some of the best ways to view a show in the city! Whether it's a table, a seat or a suite, we've got you covered. For upgraded seating inquires please contact the venue directly at (801) 456-2800. Camera Policy: Personal cameras are allowed in the venue. Flash photography, video and removable lens cameras are not permitted without venue approval. Please note there are NO refunds or exchanges unless an event is cancelled or postponed. Smoking is NOT permitted inside the building. PLEASE NOTE: The below items are prohibited. - No Outside Food or Drink Allowed - No guns, knives, weapons, pepper spray, projectiles of any kind, or any other item that could be used to inflict harm. - Replicas of any type of weapon are NOT permitted • No drugs, drug paraphernalia or illegal substances of any kind - No personal video cameras, Go-Pros, selfie sticks, drones, masks or laser pointers. - No professional audio, video, or audio recording equipment - (including detachable lenses, tripods, zooms or commercial use rigs) - No unsealed liquids or gels of any kind - No jewelry or clothing that could inflict harm - No large bags over (12 inches x 12 inches x 6 inches), backpacks, Camelbacks or Bota bags - No stuffed animals or toys of any kind
generalInfo.childRule: All guests ages 3 and older need a ticket for entry. Please provide ear protection for children.
